name: Grimo Ghoul
source:
They're ghoulas serving Aoe household and a true ancestor's familiars.
Based on their looks they are still in their teens, but they were serving the family before Mai even married into it so they're thought to be really old.
Both are poor at expressing their emotions and are together at all times.
Grani is the older sister and Grimo is the younger sister.
